title: The merge tool reads main's ruleset first, then the old branch protection
why: Once the sweep moves a repo's main to a ruleset and removes the old protection, the merge tool, which reads only the old protection, would refuse every merge in that repo.
source: Owner 19:49 CST Nov 11, page item 519 pick c ("c is prob best"), relayed by the retrospective; plan restart-plan 1cce54a, R45 Rulesets paragraph
note: merge/merge.py protection_names reads GET rules/branches/<base> first and branches/<base>/protection second (today it reads only protection, lines 1257 and 1275, and stops with "has no branch protection"). skills/project-ops/scripts/protect.py sets the ruleset. Lands before the R44 sweep removes any repo's old protection. Once every repo has a ruleset, the old-protection read is deleted. The lane rewrites decision main-branch-protection, which says "The repo has no rulesets". The grant on branch grant-shared-ruleset stays as written. Waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51).
